description: This is a Python source file implementing a client for NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD) API. It includes functions to fetch APOD data, handle configuration, logging, error handling, and HTTP requests asynchronously. The file defines a custom exception, constants, and a main fetch function with detailed error management.
